common: This is a fictional negotiation in integer credits, not a real purchase. You do not know the other party's private limit. The buyer opens and there are at most 8 alternating host turns. This invocation handles your current turn only. First call get_negotiation to read the current public state, then choose one move using the available tools. A successful move ends your turn. If a tool returns an error, you may choose a corrected call in this same turn. Negotiate naturally and concisely. Reply with exactly one JSON object with keys name, arguments, and reason: name is one available tool name, arguments is its argument object, and reason is one short user-facing sentence explaining the action.
